title: Next-step quality / mutual commitment

questions.text: Is there a concrete, mutually understood next step, or are we creating activity without progress?

inputs: the candidate's next step and CRM next-step intent

criteria.guide: The step names what happens, not 'touch base' or 'just checking in'.

criteria.text: buyer-side and seller-side owner are clear where applicable
criteria.guide: Who does what on each side is stated or unambiguous from the thread.

har97.text: * buyer-side and seller-side owner are clear where applicable

criteria.text: timing/date is explicit where the customer has agreed one
criteria.guide: If the customer agreed a date or window, the step carries it; do not demand a date the customer has not agreed.

har97.text: * timing/date is explicit where the customer has agreed one

criteria.guide: The step continues what either side already committed to rather than replacing it.

criteria.text: the system does not invent a commitment the buyer never made
criteria.guide: Every buyer-side commitment the action relies on appears in the evidence.

har97.text: * the system does not invent a commitment the buyer never made

failure_examples: generic “just checking in” after a call that had an agreed security review
asking for a new meeting when the buyer already promised an internal review first
leaving the call with no concrete next move despite clear momentum

diagnostics.name: no_mutual_next_step
diagnostics.when: no concrete, mutually understood next step results from the action

diagnostics.name: next_step_missing_owner_or_date
diagnostics.when: the step lacks an owner, or a date the customer agreed
